rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese term for the punctuation mark used at the end of a sentence.

example.english: Add a full stop at the end of this sentence, otherwise it won't be complete.
example.traditional: 呢句句尾要加句號，唔係就唔完整。
example.jyutping: ni1 geoi3 geoi3 mei5 jiu3 gaa1 geoi3 hou6 m4 hai6 zau6 m4 jyun4 zing2
